text: Core Purpose: Have every child experience the inspiration and mysticism embodied in Indian and World Heritage. 4th March 2024 To, Sh Kumar Tuhin, Director General, Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) Azad Bhavan, I.P. Estate New Delhi - 110 002 India Subject: Request for Support to Facilitate International Participation in SPIC MACAY 9th International Convention at IIT Madras, May 20-26 2024 Dear Sir/Madam, Greetings from SPIC MACAY! I hope this letter finds you in good health and high spirits. I first wish to express our gratitude for all the support that the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR) has extended to SPIC MACAY over the years. As you may be aware, SPIC MACAY organizes an annual flagship event, the International Convention, hosted by an eminent educational institution like IIT or IIM, which showcases the rich cultural heritage, Virasat of India through classical and folk performances, handicraft workshops, and various immersive activities like early morning Yoga, meditation, film screenings, expert talks, heritage walks etc. The upcoming 9th International Convention is scheduled to take place at IIT Madras from May 20 to 26, 2024. Last year Dr Vinay Saha
source: Finance and Fundraising/ICCR/ICCR Proposal-International Participation.docx

text: Yoga, meditation, film screenings, expert talks, heritage walks etc. The upcoming 9th International Convention is scheduled to take place at IIT Madras from May 20 to 26, 2024. Last year Dr Vinay Sahasrabuddhe, President ICCR, inaugurated our 8th International Convention at VNIT Nagpur. In our conversations, he had assured us ICCR’s support for getting international participation. SPIC MACAY has always strived to provide an ashram-like atmosphere during the week-long convention, allowing over 1200 school and college students, as well as volunteers from across India, to immerse themselves in the cultural tapestry of our nation. The participants are treated to mesmerizing performances by some of the most renowned classical and folk artists, making it a unique and unforgettable experience. In the past, we have had international participants from countries such as Pakistan, South Korea, Sri Lanka, and Nepal, contributing to a diverse and enriching cultural exchange. This year, we would be immensely grateful if ICCR could facilitate the participation of students from South Asian countries or elsewhere, continuing the tradition of fostering global harmony through cultural understanding.
source: Finance and Fundraising/ICCR/ICCR Proposal-International Participation.docx

text: immensely grateful if ICCR could facilitate the participation of students from South Asian countries or elsewhere, continuing the tradition of fostering global harmony through cultural understanding. Additionally, we kindly request ICCR's assistance in arranging for an international artist or artist group to perform at the convention. In the past, we have had the privilege of hosting diverse performances, including Whirling Dervishes from Turkey and a Gregorian Chants group from France. Such contributions significantly enhance the cultural diversity of the event and are instrumental in broadening the participants' perspectives. SPIC MACAY will take care of the on-campus accommodation and food arrangements for the participants & artist, and we are only seeking support for their travel to the venue in Chennai. Your continued support in this endeavor would undoubtedly contribute to the success of the 9th International Convention. We appreciate ICCR's unwavering commitment to promoting cultural exchange and understanding, and we are confident that your support will further strengthen the bond between our organizations. Many of these articles reinstate the philosophy and ideology that, like our rich cultural heritage, have been passed on through generations. Others re ﬂ ect concepts, discussions and experimentations with ideas during various stages of the movement. For them it has been a unique experience challenging and elevating at the same time. text: in a big pandal and we would go basically to look at the ‘interesting’ people who had come to listen to the concerts. Classical music was the last priority for. Years passed. We graduated and many of us went abroad. While doing my PhD at Columbia University in New York in the early seventies, I came across a small advertisement in a weekly newspaper ‘Village V oice’. It was about an upcoming dhrupad concert by Ustad Nasir Aminuddin Dagar and Ustad Zia Fariduddin Dagar at the Brooklyn Academy of Music, New York, under the aegis of the Asia society. A group of us said ‘Chalo dekhen’ (not ‘sune’). None of us knew what dhrupad was or who the Dagars were. I went into the concert walking on ground but came out walking an inch above it. A seed planted during my IIT days had emerged as a wondrous plant. The ‘black box’ concept in science could describe it quite appropriately. I knew the input to the box and the output, but not what took place inside. I realized, what had happened to me could happen to others too. text: happen to others too. Under the aegis of the India Club of Columbia University, i started organizing concerts of great classical Indian artistes passing through New York. I also started learning Indian classical music. After completion of my PhD, I joined Bell Labs in New Jersey but kept in touch with the concerts and continued my own learning. In 1976 when I returned to India to teach at IIT Delhi, I remember asking my students if anyone had ever heard the name of one of the greatest sitar players Pandit Nikhil Banerjee, who was alive at that time. Not a single student raised his hand. It rang an alarm bell and we decided to do something about it. At that time I was teaching Operations Research to the ﬁ nal year ME students. With this batch we set up MEFORG (Mechanical Engineering Chintan 5 Final Year Operational Research Group) and decided to organize a concert. We publicized it widely and I was quite sure that we would be able to ﬁ ll at least half of our Convocation Hall, which has a capacity of about 1500. text: Core Purpose: Have every child experience the inspiration and mysticism embodied in Indian and World Heritage. 8th February 2024 To, The Director, IIT Hyderabad SUBJECT: Proposal to host SPIC MACAY 10th International Convention in IIT Hyderabad 26th May to 1st June 2025 Respected Sir, We thank you for your interest to our proposal for hosting 10th SPIC MACAY International Convention in IIT Hyderabad from Mon, 26 May to Sun, 1 Jun 2025 . Dr. Sowmya is a fine exponent of the Saraswati Vina, one of the world's oldest musical instruments. She is currently the Vice Chancellor of the Tamil Nadu Dr J Jayalalithaa Music & Fine Arts University and a Visiting Professor at The Music Academy, Madras. text: ORGANISING CONVENTIONS A SPIC MACAY Convention deepens a student’s experience of Indian heritage by presenting ALL the SPICMACAY modules together - classical music, classical dance, folk music, folk dance, Naad yog, Hatha yog, meditation, craft, theatre, cinema classics, talks, heritage tours, holistic food. It's an immersion exercise that a participant is bound to remember for a lifetime as the best maestros interact, teach and perform. Volunteers from across the country work hard to put this mammoth exercise together. Here is a document that could help reduce last minute glitches. Though it refers to International Conventions primarily; with relevant tweaking, it could apply to International or Rural School Intensives; shorter Zonal, State, District or City Conventions. ETHOS & MANDATE: The ethos is to subtly introduce the young mind to transactionlessness, something that India's sages and culture is known for. To give without expecting to receive. text: CAY’S 6TH INTERNATIONAL CONVENTION IN ITS 41ST YEAR at IIT Kharagpur 3-9 (Sun-Sat) June 2018 In its 41st year, Society for the Promotion of Indian Classical Music and Culture Amongst Youth (SPIC MACAY) is organising its annual International Convention at IIT Kharagpur from 3-9 June, 2018. SPIC MACAY’s annual international convention is an opportunity for youth from across the world to experience the cultural and traditional values that India has preserved in various forms for ages. Throughout the year SPIC MACAY organizes over 5,000 programmes in India and abroad through its 300 local and 20 global chapters. While these events are distinctly individual contributions into making the SPIC MACAY movement, the seven days of the convention are its zenith as volunteers and members from world over come together to experience the wholesome “mystique” of India. The schedule of the convention is such that during this one week, a person is away from the distractions of the world that is bombarded with too much knowledge and information. The participants “slow down” to savour, understand, introspect and derive their own outlook into Indian culture and heritage and its ethics. The activities in
source: Copy of About Organising Conventions.docx

text: with too much knowledge and information. The participants “slow down” to savour, understand, introspect and derive their own outlook into Indian culture and heritage and its ethics. The activities in the convention range from classical music and dance concerts, performances of folk arts, crafts, intensive workshops, classic cinema screenings, yoga and meditation sessions and shramdaan. The idea of the convention is to create a unique ashram-like atmosphere with minimal interaction with modern-day living to leave an impact on the young generation. A day at the convention starts with getting up at 3.30 am during the very special time called the ‘Brahma Muhurat’, doing various kinds of ‘yog’ or meditation for three hours with the gurus. Participants themselves choose from options like Naad Yog, Hath Yog, Dhrupad and Kutiyattam for this. This is followed by the ‘Shramdaan’, with an idea to give back a cleaner place to the hosts than how they gave it to the participants. After this, the participants attend intensives - a daily three-hour workshop on 48 arts including Hindustani Vocal, Carnatic vocal, Dhrupad, Kathak, Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattam, Odissi, Kudiyattam, Hatha Yog

The intensives are conducted by great masters in their respective fields. After the intensives, the participants get to attend talks by eminent personalities, movie screenings and concerts in the afternoon. SPIC MACAY’s intention is to enrich the quality of formal education by increasing awareness about different aspects of Indian heritage and inspiring the young mind to imbibe values embedded in it. Approximately 600 accomplished artistes of the country render programmes of Indian classical music and dance, folk, poetry, theatre, traditional paintings, crafts & yog in the premises of an education institution. SPICMACAY- the Society for the Promotion of Indian Classical Music and Culture amongst Youth is a non-political voluntary movement that organizes programmes of classical music and dance, folk art, craft, yoga, classic cinema screenings, heritage walks, etc. inside school and college campuses throughout the country and the world to make students more aware about Indian and world heritage. This initiative makes education more holistic and meaningful as it highlights all that is abstract, subtle, inspiring and mystical in the world, teaching one to look within oneself. For her, painting is more than an expression on canvas. Also a writer and a short filmmaker, she finds expression for her thoughts not through words but in designs and Motifs. The workshop on Gond paintings was conducted by Shri Gareeba Singh Teekam. Gond paintings are a form of painting from folk and tribal art that is practiced by one of the largest tribes in India with whom it shares its name. Gond comes from the Dravidian expression, Kond which means ‘the green mountain’. While Gond paintings are considered to be from predominantly from Madhya Pradesh, it is also quite common in Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh and Odisha. text: (PI) Registration This is not an individual registration. Please DO NOT ask students to fill this up. It has to be filled by a school ONLY IF 5 students and a teacher can residentially attend for all seven days in IIT Madras from 20th May to 26th May 2024. Please collect this information from each student and share with their Name, Class, Parent Name, Parent Mobile Number, Blood Group. Once you register and the cheque is received, there will be a selection process (as there are only a limited numbers of delegates who can be accepted). Once you receive a confirmation from us over email, you can book your to and fro tickets to Chennai. To help us make a selection, please mention within 100 words or one page on why you want to come for the convention. Notes: Participants are requested to please send us a refundable deposit via Cheque in the name of " SPIC MACAY " of Rs. 1000/- per participant. It will be refunded to participants once participant attends the Convention. text: itution (PI) Registration This is not an individual registration. Please DO NOT ask students to fill this up. It has to be filled by a school ONLY IF 5 students and a teacher can residentially attend for all seven days in IIT Madras from 20th May to 26th May 2024. Please collect this information from each student and share with their Name, Class, Parent Name, Parent Mobile Number, Blood Group. Once you register and the cheque is received, there will be a selection process (as there are only a limited numbers of delegates who can be accepted). Once you receive a confirmation from us over email, you can book your to and fro tickets to Chennai. To help us make a selection, please mention within 100 words or one page on why you want to come for the convention. Notes: Participants are requested to please send us a refundable deposit via Cheque in the name of " SPIC MACAY " of Rs. 1000/- per participant. It will be refunded to participants once participant attends the Convention. text: Core Purpose: Have every child experience the inspiration and mysticism embodied in Indian and World Heritage. International Convention FAQs (Frequently Asked Questions) Travel How do I plan my travel? Plan such that your arrival in the convention town is anytime before 8 AM on Day 1. And plan your departure, after you complete the heritage tour you choose. What is the last date until when I can stay at the venue? You can stay at the venue until after your heritage tour is completed. You will not be allowed to stay back after this time. Please plan your departures accordingly. What is the convenient way to reach convention venue? Chennai is well connected by flight, train and bus. You may choose anything as per your convenience. Flight – alight at Dr Baba sahib Ambedkar International Airport, Chennai Train – alight at Chennai Junction Railway station Bus – alight at Chennai Bus Stand. From airport/ railway station/ bus stand, how do I reach the venue? Delegates will have to arrange their travel to/from airport and or railway stations to the venue on their own and bear the transportation. SPIC MACAY wont be providing transport from airport/ station to the venue. Transport Coordinato
source: Registration/International Convention FAQs.docx

Transport Coordinator name and number is: …… Will SPICMACAY sponsor my travel from my home to Convention venue and back? No. Food Do I have to pay for my food? You do not have to pay. SPICMACAY will take care of it for you☺ You will be given holistic vegetarian food throughout the convention. You must stand in a queue and wait patiently for your turn before you get the food. In the welcome kit, you will be given food coupons - one for each meal of the day for all days. Please present your coupon at the food counter to get food. Do not waste food at any point of the time. You can go for multiple servings. Keep your used plates only in designated areas. Can I carry some snacks from home to eat at the convention? No. We strongly discourage participants from eating any snacks for the entire week as it will dilute the nourishment experience that holistic food provides. I have never taken my dinner at 5.30pm, will I not be hungry by morning? Will I not feel tired by night? Food timings are carefully designed to
source: Registration/International Convention FAQs.docx

text: the nourishment experience that holistic food provides. I have never taken my dinner at 5.30pm, will I not be hungry by morning? Will I not feel tired by night? Food timings are carefully designed to match the energy and nutrition requirement of the day long activity. It is important that you take food at the scheduled timings and not skip any meal of the day or eat something else later. Accommodation What is the plan for my accommodation? Your accommodation will be arranged at the venue. It is a gated campus. There will be separate hostels for boys and girls. It will be simple hostel rooms that you share with few others. As the whole convention is in an ashram-like setting, you will be provided mattresses and sleep on the floor. Please bring 2 bedsheets and 1 pillow cover with you. Accompanying teachers will stay with the students. Male accompanying teachers will be given a room in boys hostel and female teachers in girls hostel. There are common baths and toilets on every floor. At the registration welcome desk, you will be allotted a room with your registration ID. Rooms once allotted will not be changed unless there is an emergency. Please keep your room clean. Throw garbage o
source: Registration/International Convention FAQs.docx

text: the registration welcome desk, you will be allotted a room with your registration ID. Rooms once allotted will not be changed unless there is an emergency. Please keep your room clean. Throw garbage only in the dust bin. Be cordial with your fellow roommates. Switch off lights and fan before leaving the room. Do not lock the room as you share it with many others. Lock only your luggage. I am the female accompanying teacher and my school team has a mix of boys and girls. How do I meet the boys? You may decide on one common point like - outside the hostel, at food counter, or at the main hall at the start of the convention and can meet them daily at the same place on a mutually decided time like - before the intensives start, after the yoga is over, before the evening programs start etc. Will I have access to washing machines in the hostels? Please bring enough clothes for the entire week. You will neither have time nor any option to wash it on campus. The Convention Week What should we look forward to in a week-long convention? Room sharing, shramdaan, cleaning the campus, maintaining discipline help.
